subject: Incorporating error radii from new Argos-Kinéis data

messages.author: 7f7950404d623748
messages.subject: Incorporating error radii from new Argos-Kinéis data
parts:
Hi Chris,

I am planning to use ctmm with telemetry data from the brand new Argos-Kinéis satellite constellation. As of this year, Argos data no longer comes with error ellipse variables. This new system instead provides circular error radii (in meters) for all location classes (3, 2, 1, A, and B). Because positions are now estimated using the 20 new Kinéis satellites in addition to the 5 Argos legacy satellites, these error radii are far more accurate than the location class error ranges estimated with the old Least Squares method. Are you aware of this transition with Argos data, and does ctmm have plans to be able to import Argos data in as.telemetry() that have a single error radius column instead of the three error ellipse variables?

Thanks in advance!
Maina

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: Incorporating error radii from new Argos-Kinéis data
parts:
Hi Maina,

I was not aware. Thanks for the update. Can you send me an example dataset so that I can make sure that it imports correctly?

Best,
Chris
